`spirit/packets/router.py`:

```py
import logging
import inspect

from spirit.network.protocol import WargFlags
from spirit.network.message_names import InboundMsg
from .handlers.handshake import HandshakeHandler
from .handlers.auth import AuthHandler
from .handlers.system import SystemHandler
from .handlers.data_sync import DataSyncHandler
from .handlers.social import SocialHandler
from .handlers.shop import ShopHandler
from .handlers.redemption import RedemptionHandler
from .handlers.trade import TradeHandler
from .handlers.matchmaking import MatchmakingHandler
from .handlers.gameplay import GameplayHandler
from .handlers.tournaments import TournamentHandler

HANDLER_CLASSES = [
    HandshakeHandler,
    AuthHandler,
    SystemHandler,
    DataSyncHandler,
    SocialHandler,
    ShopHandler,
    RedemptionHandler,
    TradeHandler,
    MatchmakingHandler,
    GameplayHandler,
    TournamentHandler,
]

class PacketRouter:
    def __init__(self, client):
        self.client = client
        # {msg_name: (bound_handler, is_coroutine)}
        self.handlers = {}
        self.register_handlers()

    def register_handlers(self):
        for handler_cls in HANDLER_CLASSES:
            instance = handler_cls(self.client)
            for msg_name, func in instance.get_handlers().items():
                self.handlers[msg_name] = (func, inspect.iscoroutinefunction(func))

    async def route(self, message, request_id, flags):
        # Determine message name
        msg_name = None
        if isinstance(message, dict):
            msg_name = message.get("name")
            if not msg_name:
                # Duck-typing heuristic for unwrapped messages
                if "queueName" in message and "gameID" in message and "path" in message:
                    msg_name = InboundMsg.READY_FOR_MATCH_CONFIRMATION.value
                    # Re-wrap as a standard polymorphic message structure
                    message = {"name": msg_name, "value": message}

        elif hasattr(message, "DESCRIPTOR"):
            # For protobuf, we usually have a wrapper or need to know the type
            # The protocol.py currently passes the unwrapped proto object
            msg_name = message.DESCRIPTOR.full_name

        if not msg_name:
            logging.warning(f"[TCP] [{self.client.addr}] Unhandled packet received (no message name / unwrapped JSON): {message}")
            return

        entry = self.handlers.get(msg_name)
        if entry:
            handler_func, is_coro = entry
            try:
                payload = message.get("value") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
                if is_coro:
                    await handler_func(payload, request_id, flags)
                else:
                    handler_func(payload, request_id, flags)
            except Exception as e:
                logging.error(f"[TCP] [{self.client.addr}] Error in handler {msg_name}: {e}", exc_info=True)
        else:
            logging.warning(f"[TCP] [{self.client.addr}] No handler registered for message: {msg_name}")

    async def handle_raw_protobuf(self, message_name, proto_obj, request_id, flags):
        """
        Special entry point for protobuf messages that were identified by the protocol layer.
        """
        entry = self.handlers.get(message_name)
        if entry:
            handler_func, is_coro = entry
            if is_coro:
                await handler_func(proto_obj, request_id, flags)
            else:
                handler_func(proto_obj, request_id, flags)
        else:
            logging.warning(f"[TCP] [{self.client.addr}] No handler for Protobuf message: {message_name}")

```

```pyi
from google.protobuf import descriptor as _descriptor
from google.protobuf import message as _message
from google.protobuf.internal import containers as _containers
from typing import ClassVar as _ClassVar, Iterable as _Iterable, Mapping as _Mapping, Optional as _Optional, Union as _Union

class UUID(_message.Message):
    __slots__ = ["lo", "hi"]

When their season points cross a milestone, its rewards are granted automatically — tokens go to the wallet, cards and products go to the collection. The ladder is split into <b>tiers</b>: the in-game screen shows one tier at a time and auto-advances to the tier holding the player's next milestone. Click a milestone's number to edit its point threshold. The game renders up to 3 reward arts per milestone (cards fan out, packs show a single tile); a milestone with several rewards must include at least one card or product.</div>

<script>
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
let PRODUCTS = [], REWARD = {products:{}};

function toast(msg, err=false) {
  const t = $('#toast');
  t.textContent = msg; t.className = err ? 'err' : ''; t.style.display = 'block';
  clearTimeout(t._h); t._h = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 3000);
}
async function api(path, body) {
  const opts = body ? {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body)} : {};
  const res = await fetch('/admin/api/' + path, opts);
  const data = await res.json();
  if (res.status === 401) { showLogin(); throw new Error(data.error || 'authentication required'); }
  if (!data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'request failed');
  return data;
}

/* ---------------- Auth ---------------- */
function showLogin() {
  $('#loginOverlay').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(() => $('#loginUser').focus(), 50);
}
async function doLogin() {
  $('#loginError').textContent = '';
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/admin/api/login', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({username: $('#loginUser').value.trim(), password: $('#loginPass').value})
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.ok) { $('#loginError').textContent = data.error || 'Login failed'; return; }
    $('#loginOverlay').classList.remove('open');
    $('#loginPass').value = '';
    $('#whoami').textContent = data.username;
    $('#logoutBtn').style.display = '';
    bootData();
  } catch(e) { $('#loginError').textContent = e.message; }
}
async function logout() {
  try { await fetch('/admin/api/logout', {method: 'POST'}); } catch(e) {}
  location.reload();
}
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const CURRENCY_NAMES = {'-1784319558':'Coins','2012906479':'Gems','-992199324':'Tickets'};
const TYPE_NAMES = {21:'Booster', 4:'Deck', 22:'Coin', 24:'Sleeve', 23:'Deck Box', 6:'Currency'};

document.querySelectorAll('nav button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('nav button').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
  b.classList.add('active');
  $('#tab-' + b.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
  if (b.dataset.tab === 'pages') { loadPageAssets(); loadPages(); }
});

async function loadOverview() {
  try {
    const d = await api('overview');
    $('#headerStats').textContent = `${d.accounts} accounts · ${d.codes} codes · ${d.shop_items} shop items`;
    $('#overviewGrid').innerHTML = [
      ['Accounts', d.accounts], ['Redemption Codes', d.codes], ['Shop Items', d.shop_items],
      ['Dynamic Pages', d.pages], ['Trade Offers', d.trades], ['Eligible Sets', d.eligible_sets.length]
    ].map(([l,n]) => `<div class="stat"><div class="n">${n}</div><div class="l">${l}</div></div>`).join('');
    const rows = Object.entries(d.set_counts).sort((a,b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    $('#setsTable tbody').innerHTML = rows.map(([code,count]) =>
      `<tr><td><code>${esc(code)}</code></td><td>${count}</td>
       <td>${d.eligible_sets.includes(code) ? '<span class="pill on">yes</span>' : '<span class="pill off">no</span>'}</td></tr>`).join('');
  } catch(e) { toast('Overview: ' + e.message, true); }
}

async function loadProducts() {
  try {
    const d = await api('products');
    PRODUCTS = d.products;
    $('#shopProduct').innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(p =>
      `<option value="${p.guid}">[${esc(p.key)}] ${esc(p.name || p.guid)} (${TYPE_NAMES[p.product_type] || p.product_type})</option>`).join('');
  } catch(e) { toast('Products: ' + e.message, true); }
}

/* guid -> {name, image} resolution for reward chips (cards + products) */
let CARD_META = {};
function metaFor(guid) {
  const g = String(guid || '').toLowerCase();
  if (CARD_META[g]) return CARD_META[g];
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.guid.toLowerCase() === g);
  if (p) return {name: p.name || p.guid, image: p.image ? `/products/${p.image}.png` : null, product: true};
  return null;
}
async function resolveCardMeta(guids) {
  const missing = [...new Set(guids.map(g => String(g).toLowerCase()))].filter(g => !metaFor(g));
  if (!missing.length) return false;
  try {
    const d = await api('cards/lookup', {guids: missing});
    for (const [g, c] of Object.entries(d.cards)) {
      CARD_META[g] = {name: c.name ? `${c.name} (${c.set} ${c.number})` : g, image: c.image};
    }
    for (const g of missing) if (!CARD_META[g]) CARD_META[g] = {name: g.slice(0, 8) + '…', image: null};
    return true;
  } catch(e) { return false; }
}

/* ---------------- Accounts ---------------- */
async function loadAccounts() {
  try {
    const d = await api('accounts');
    $('#accountsTable tbody').innerHTML = d.accounts.map(a => `
      <tr><td>${esc(a.username)}</td><td>${esc(a.screen_name)}</td>
      <td class="muted">${esc(a.account_id)}</td>
      <td>${a.is_admin ? '<span class="pill on">admin</span>' : '<span class="muted">—</span>'}</td>
      <td><button class="mini" onclick="grantAllCards('${esc(a.account_id)}', this)">Give 4× all cards</button>
          <button class="mini" onclick="grantAllProducts('${esc(a.account_id)}', this)">Give 1× all products</button>
          <button class="mini" onclick="setAdmin('${esc(a.account_id)}', ${!a.is_admin})">${a.is_admin ? 'Revoke admin' : 'Make admin'}</button></td></tr>`).join('')
      || '<tr><td colspan="5" class="muted">No accounts.</td></tr>';
  } catch(e) { toast('Accounts: ' + e.message, true); }
}
async function setAdmin(account_id, is_admin) {
  if (!confirm((is_admin ? 'Grant' : 'Revoke') + ' dashboard admin rights for this account?')) return;
  try { await api('accounts/set-admin', {account_id, is_admin}); toast('Updated'); loadAccounts(); }
  catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}
async function grantAllCards(account_id, btn) {
  if (!confirm('Give 4 tradable copies of every card to this account?')) return;
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Granting…'; }
  try {
    const d = await api('accounts/grant-all-cards', {account_id, count: 4});
    toast(`Granted 4× of ${d.granted} cards`);
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
  finally { if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Give 4× all cards'; } }
}
async function grantAllProducts(account_id, btn) {
  if (!confirm('Give 1 tradable copy of every product (boosters, decks, coins, sleeves, deck boxes) to this account?')) return;
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Granting…'; }
  try {
    const d = await api('accounts/grant-all-products', {account_id, count: 1});
    toast(`Granted 1× of ${d.granted} products`);
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
  finally { if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Give 1× all products'; } }
}

/* ---------------- Codes ---------------- */
function rewardSummary(r) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const [g,c] of Object.entries(r.products || {})) {
    const m = metaFor(g);
    parts.push(`${c}× ${m ? m.name : g.slice(0,8) + '…'}`);
  }
  if (r.coins) parts.push(r.coins + ' coins');
  if (r.gems) parts.push(r.gems + ' gems');
  if (r.tickets) parts.push(r.tickets + ' tickets');
  return parts.length ? parts.map(x => `<span class="pill tag">${esc(x)}</span>`).join('') : '<span class="muted">empty</span>';
}
function updateRewardItems() {
  $('#rewardItems').innerHTML = Object.entries(REWARD.products).map(([g, c]) => {
    const m = metaFor(g) || {name: g.slice(0,8) + '…', image: null};
    const art = m.image ? `<img src="${esc(m.image)}" onerror="this.remove()">` : '<div class="coin">🎴</div>';
    return `<div class="reward-chip">${art}<span class="rc-name">${esc(m.name)}</span>
      <span class="rc-amt">×${c}</span>
      <button class="chip-x" onclick="removeRewardItem('${esc(g)}')">✕</button></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function removeRewardItem(guid) {
  delete REWARD.products[guid];
  updateRewardItems();
}
function currentReward() {
  return {
    products: REWARD.products,
    coins: parseInt($('#codeCoins').value || 0),
    gems: parseInt($('#codeGems').value || 0),
    tickets: parseInt($('#codeTickets').value || 0)
  };
}
async function createCode() {
  try {
    await api('codes', {
      code: $('#codeInput').value.trim() || undefined,
      count: parseInt($('#codeCount').value || 1),
      max_uses: parseInt($('#codeMaxUses').value || 1),
      reward: currentReward()
    });
    REWARD = {products:{}}; $('#rewardPreview').textContent = ''; $('#codeInput').value = '';
    updateRewardItems();
    toast('Code created'); loadCodes(); loadOverview();
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}
async function loadCodes() {
  try {
    const d = await api('codes');
    const guids = d.codes.flatMap(c => Object.keys((c.reward_json || {}).products || {}));
    if (await resolveCardMeta(guids)) { /* meta now cached for the render below */ }
    $('#codesTable tbody').innerHTML = d.codes.map(c => `
      <tr><td><code>${esc(c.code_string)}</code></td>
      <td>${rewardSummary(c.reward_json || {})}</td>
      <td>${c.current_uses} / ${c.max_uses === 0 ? '∞' : c.max_uses}</td>
      <td>${c.enabled ? '<span class="pill on">active</span>' : '<span class="pill off">disabled</span>'}</td>
      <td><button class="mini" onclick="toggleCode('${esc(c.code_string)}', ${!c.enabled})">${c.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}</button>
          <button class="mini" onclick="deleteCode('${esc(c.code_string)}')">Delete</button></td></tr>`).join('');
  } catch(e) { toast('Codes: ' + e.message, true); }
}
async function toggleCode(code, enabled) {
  try { await api('codes/update', {code, enabled}); loadCodes(); } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}
async function deleteCode(code) {
  if (!confirm('Delete code ' + code + '?')) return;
  try { await api('codes/delete', {code}); toast('Deleted'); loadCodes(); loadOverview(); } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}

/* ---------------- Shop ---------------- */
async function loadShop() {
  try {
    const d = await api('shop');
    $('#shopTable tbody').innerHTML = d.items.map(i => {
      const p = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.guid === i.product_guid);
      const flags = [i.featured && 'Featured', i.top_selling && 'Top'].filter(Boolean)
        .map(f => `<span class="pill tag">${f}</span>`).join('') || '<span class="muted">—</span>';
      return `<tr><td>${esc(i.display_name || (p ? p.name : i.product_guid))}<div class="muted">${esc(i.product_guid)}</div></td>
        <td>${i.price} ${CURRENCY_NAMES[i.currency] || i.currency}</td>
        <td>${flags}</td>
        <td>${i.enabled ? '<span class="pill on">on</span>' : '<span class="pill off">off</span>'}</td>
        <td><button class="mini" onclick='editShopItem(${JSON.stringify(i)})'>Edit</button>
            <button class="mini" onclick="toggleShopItem(${i.id})">${i.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}</button>
            <button class="mini" onclick="deleteShopItem(${i.id})">Delete</button></td></tr>`;
    }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="5" class="muted">No custom shop items — auto boosters only.</td></tr>';
  } catch(e) { toast('Shop: ' + e.message, true); }
}
function editShopItem(i) {

function clearShopForm() {

/* ---------------- Pages ---------------- */
const PAGE_FOREVER = 4102444800000;
const PAGE_TEMPLATES = [
  // Unity names these prefabs for the TEXT side, not the artwork side.
  {id:'LandingPageLeft', label:'Artwork on right', sub:'Message and CTA on the left', visual:'visual-right', copy:'left', buttons:true},
  {id:'LandingPageRight', label:'Artwork on left', sub:'Message and CTA on the right', visual:'visual-left', copy:'right', buttons:true},
  {id:'LandingPageLeftNoButtons', label:'Artwork right, no CTA', sub:'Message on the left', visual:'visual-right no-buttons', copy:'left', buttons:false},
  {id:'LandingPageRightNoButtons', label:'Artwork left, no CTA', sub:'Message on the right', visual:'visual-left no-buttons', copy:'right', buttons:false}
];
const PAGE_CTA_LABELS = {
  shop:'VISIT SHOP', redeem:'REDEEM CODE', tournament:'VIEW EVENTS', trade:'OPEN TRADE', url:'LEARN MORE'
};
let DYNAMIC_PAGES = [];
let PAGE_ASSETS = [];
let PAGE_ASSET_BY_NAME = {};
let PAGE_ASSETS_LOADED = false;
let PAGE_ASSET_REVISION = 0;
let PAGE_BASE_CONTENT = {};
let PAGE_EDITOR_INITIALIZED = false;
let PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL = '';

const cloneJson = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value || {}));
const pageAssetName = path => String(path || '').trim().replaceAll('\\', '/').split('/').pop();
const pageAssetUrl = (name, variant='preview') => `/admin/api/pages/assets/${variant}/${encodeURIComponent(pageAssetName(name))}?v=${PAGE_ASSET_REVISION}`;
const pageAssetMeta = path => {
  const normalized = normalizedPageAssetPath(path);
  if (!/^LandingPage\/[^/]+$/i.test(normalized)) return null;
  return PAGE_ASSET_BY_NAME[pageAssetName(normalized).toLowerCase()] || null;
};

function defaultDynamicContent(type='landing') {
  if (type === 'maintenance') {
    const start = Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000) * 60000;
    return {
      template: 'SplashMaintenanceWindow', sortOrder: nextPageOrder(), startTime:start, endTime:start + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      labels: {NotificationBody: {token: 'spirit.dynamic_page.maintenance', bundle: {en_US: ''}}},
      images: {}, actions: {}
    };
  }
  return {
    template: 'LandingPageLeft', sortOrder: nextPageOrder(), startTime: 0, endTime: PAGE_FOREVER,
    labels: {GameText: {token: 'spirit.dynamic_page.game_text', bundle: {en_US: ''}}},
    images: {}, actions: {}
  };
}

function nextPageOrder() {
  return DYNAMIC_PAGES.length ? Math.max(...DYNAMIC_PAGES.map(p => parseInt(p.sort_order) || 0)) + 1 : 1;
}

function labelText(content, key) {
  const label = content?.labels?.[key];
  const bundle = label?.bundle;
  if (!bundle || typeof bundle !== 'object') return String(label?.token || '');
  return String(bundle.en_US ?? Object.values(bundle)[0] ?? label?.token ?? '');
}

function backgroundPath(content) {
  const map = content?.images?.GameBackground?.localeImageMap;
  if (!map || typeof map !== 'object') return '';
  return String(map.en_US ?? Object.values(map)[0] ?? '');
}

function actionEditorValue(content) {
  const code = content?.actions?.CodeRedeemButton;
  const action = code || content?.actions?.UpsellButton;
  if (!action || typeof action !== 'object') return {kind:'none', url:''};
  if (action.name === 'NavigateToUrl') return {kind:'url', url:String(action.value?.url || '')};
  if (action.name === 'NavigateToUrls') {
    const urls = action.value?.urls || {};
    return {kind:'url', url:String(urls.en_US ?? Object.values(urls)[0] ?? '')};
  }
  const byScene = {Shop:'shop', ShopCodeRedemption:'redeem', Tournament:'tournament', Trade:'trade'};
  return {kind:byScene[action.value?.scene] || 'none', url:''};
}

function newDynamicPage(type='landing') {
  const content = defaultDynamicContent(type);
  hydratePageEditor({page_type:type, sort_order:content.sortOrder, enabled:true, content_json:content});
}

// Kept as a compatibility alias for bookmarks/dev-console snippets from the old editor.
function loadPageTemplate() { newDynamicPage($('#pageType').value || 'landing'); }

function hydratePageEditor(page) {
  const type = page.page_type === 'maintenance' ? 'maintenance' : 'landing';
  const content = cloneJson(page.content_json || defaultDynamicContent(type));
  PAGE_BASE_CONTENT = content;
  $('#pageId').value = page.id ?? '';
  $('#pageType').value = type;
  $('#pageSort').value = page.sort_order ?? content.sortOrder ?? nextPageOrder();
  $('#pageEnabled').checked = page.enabled !== false;

  const template = PAGE_TEMPLATES.some(t => t.id === content.template) ? content.template : 'LandingPageLeft';
  $('#pageTemplate').value = template;
  $('#pageAssetPath').value = backgroundPath(content);
  $('#pageMessage').value = labelText(content, 'GameText');
  $('#pageMaintenanceMessage').value = labelText(content, 'NotificationBody');
  const action = actionEditorValue(content);
  $('#pageCta').value = action.kind;
  $('#pageCtaUrl').value = action.url;
  const storedButtonLabel = labelText(content, 'ButtonText');
  $('#pageCtaLabel').value = storedButtonLabel || PAGE_CTA_LABELS[action.kind] || '';
  $('#pageCtaLabel').dataset.auto = String(!storedButtonLabel || storedButtonLabel === PAGE_CTA_LABELS[action.kind]);
  $('#pageCtaLabel').dataset.kind = action.kind;
  const start = Number(content.startTime || 0);
  const end = Number(content.endTime ?? PAGE_FOREVER);
  $('#pageStart').value = start > 0 ? msToLocal(start) : '';
  $('#pageEnd').value = end > 0 && (type === 'maintenance' || end < PAGE_FOREVER) ? msToLocal(end) : '';

  $('#pageEditorKicker').textContent = page.id ? `Editing page #${page.id}` : 'New dynamic page';
  $('#pageEditorTitle').textContent = type === 'maintenance' ? 'Build a maintenance notice' : 'Build a landing page';
  $('#pageSaveButton').textContent = page.id ? 'Save changes' : 'Create page';
  renderTemplateChoices();
  updatePageTypeFields();
  pageCtaChanged(false);
  pageEditorChanged();
}

function renderTemplateChoices() {
  const current = $('#pageTemplate').value;
  $('#pageTemplateChoices').innerHTML = PAGE_TEMPLATES.map(t => `
    <button class="template-choice ${t.id === current ? 'sel' : ''}" onclick="selectPageTemplate('${t.id}')">
      <span class="template-mini ${t.visual}"></span><strong>${esc(t.label)}</strong><small>${esc(t.sub)}</small>
    </button>`).join('');
}

function selectPageTemplate(template) {
  $('#pageTemplate').value = template;
  const def = PAGE_TEMPLATES.find(t => t.id === template);
  if (def && !def.buttons) $('#pageCta').value = 'none';
  renderTemplateChoices();
  pageCtaChanged();
}

function pageTypeChanged() {
  const maintenance = $('#pageType').value === 'maintenance';
  if (!maintenance && !PAGE_TEMPLATES.some(t => t.id === $('#pageTemplate').value)) {
    $('#pageTemplate').value = 'LandingPageLeft';
  }
  if (maintenance && !$('#pageStart').value && !$('#pageEnd').value) {
    const start = Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000) * 60000;
    $('#pageStart').value = msToLocal(start);
    $('#pageEnd').value = msToLocal(start + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  }
  $('#pageEditorTitle').textContent = maintenance ? 'Build a maintenance notice' : 'Build a landing page';
  updatePageTypeFields();
  pageEditorChanged();
}

function updatePageTypeFields() {
  const maintenance = $('#pageType').value === 'maintenance';
  $('#pageLandingFields').style.display = maintenance ? 'none' : '';
  $('#pageMaintenanceFields').style.display = maintenance ? '' : 'none';
  $('#pageStartHint').textContent = maintenance ? '(required; printed in game)' : '(blank = immediately)';
  $('#pageEndHint').textContent = maintenance ? '(required; printed in game)' : '(blank = no end date)';
  $('#pageScheduleHelp').textContent = maintenance
    ? 'These are the event dates printed in the native notice; the Enabled switch controls whether it is announced.'
    : 'Landing pages are sent to players only during this window.';
}

function pageCtaChanged(update=true) {
  const def = PAGE_TEMPLATES.find(t => t.id === $('#pageTemplate').value);
  const disabled = def && !def.buttons;
  if (disabled) $('#pageCta').value = 'none';
  const kind = $('#pageCta').value;
  const label = $('#pageCtaLabel');
  const previousKind = label.dataset.kind || 'none';
  const shouldAutofill = !label.value.trim() || label.dataset.auto === 'true'
    || label.value === (PAGE_CTA_LABELS[previousKind] || '');
  if (kind !== 'none' && shouldAutofill) {
    label.value = PAGE_CTA_LABELS[kind] || 'LEARN MORE';
    label.dataset.auto = 'true';
  }
  label.dataset.kind = kind;
  $('#pageCta').disabled = !!disabled;
  $('#pageCtaLabelField').style.display = kind === 'none' ? 'none' : '';
  $('#pageUrlField').style.display = kind === 'url' ? '' : 'none';
  $('#pageCtaHelp').textContent = disabled
    ? 'This client template intentionally has no button slot.'
    : 'The client has one CTA position; choosing one avoids overlapping buttons.';
  if (update) pageEditorChanged();
}

function pageAssetPathChanged() {
  renderSelectedPageAsset();
  pageEditorChanged();
}

function normalizedPageAssetPath(path) {
  path = String(path || '').trim().replaceAll('\\', '/');
  if (path && !path.includes('/')) path = 'LandingPage/' + path;
  return path;
}

function buildDynamicPageContent() {
  const type = $('#pageType').value;
  const content = cloneJson(PAGE_BASE_CONTENT);
  content.sortOrder = parseInt($('#pageSort').value) || 0;
  content.startTime = $('#pageStart').value ? localToMs($('#pageStart').value) : 0;
  content.endTime = $('#pageEnd').value
    ? localToMs($('#pageEnd').value)
    : (type === 'maintenance' ? 0 : PAGE_FOREVER);
  if (!content.labels || typeof content.labels !== 'object' || Array.isArray(content.labels)) content.labels = {};
  if (!content.images || typeof content.images !== 'object' || Array.isArray(content.images)) content.images = {};
  if (!content.actions || typeof content.actions !== 'object' || Array.isArray(content.actions)) content.actions = {};

  if (type === 'maintenance') {
    content.template = 'SplashMaintenanceWindow';
    const old = content.labels.NotificationBody || {};
    content.labels = {
      ...content.labels,
      NotificationBody: {
        ...old,
        token: old.token || 'spirit.dynamic_page.maintenance',
        bundle: {...(old.bundle || {}), en_US:$('#pageMaintenanceMessage').value}
      }
    };
    delete content.labels.GameText;
    delete content.labels.ButtonText;
    content.images = {};
    content.actions = {};
    return content;
  }

  content.template = $('#pageTemplate').value;
  const oldText = content.labels.GameText || {};
  content.labels.GameText = {
    ...oldText,
    token: oldText.token || 'spirit.dynamic_page.game_text',
    bundle: {...(oldText.bundle || {}), en_US:$('#pageMessage').value}
  };
  delete content.labels.NotificationBody;

  const path = normalizedPageAssetPath($('#pageAssetPath').value);
  if (path) {
    const oldBackground = content.images.GameBackground || {};
    content.images.GameBackground = {
      ...oldBackground,
      localeImageMap: {...(oldBackground.localeImageMap || {}), en_US:path}
    };
  } else {
    delete content.images.GameBackground;
  }

  delete content.actions.UpsellButton;
  delete content.actions.CodeRedeemButton;
  const kind = $('#pageCta').value;
  const sceneByKind = {shop:'Shop', redeem:'ShopCodeRedemption', tournament:'Tournament', trade:'Trade'};
  if (sceneByKind[kind]) {
    const slot = kind === 'redeem' ? 'CodeRedeemButton' : 'UpsellButton';
    content.actions[slot] = {name:'NavigateToScene', value:{scene:sceneByKind[kind]}};
  } else if (kind === 'url') {
    content.actions.UpsellButton = {name:'NavigateToUrl', value:{url:$('#pageCtaUrl').value.trim()}};
  }
  if (kind !== 'none') {
    const oldButtonText = content.labels.ButtonText || {};
    content.labels.ButtonText = {
      ...oldButtonText,
      token: oldButtonText.token || 'spirit.dynamic_page.button_text',
      bundle: {...(oldButtonText.bundle || {}), en_US:$('#pageCtaLabel').value.trim()}
    };
  } else {
    delete content.labels.ButtonText;
  }
  return content;
}

function validateDynamicPage(content) {
  const issues = [];
  const start = Number(content.startTime || 0), end = Number(content.endTime || 0);
  if (end && end <= start) issues.push({type:'err', text:'The end time must be later than the start time.'});
  if (!$('#pageEnabled').checked) issues.push({type:'info', text:'This page is disabled and will not be sent to players.'});

  if ($('#pageType').value === 'maintenance') {
    if (!labelText(content, 'NotificationBody').trim()) issues.push({type:'err', text:'Add notice text before saving.'});
    if (!$('#pageStart').value) issues.push({type:'err', text:'Choose the maintenance start shown to players.'});
    if (!$('#pageEnd').value) issues.push({type:'err', text:'Choose the maintenance end shown to players.'});
    if ($('#pageEnabled').checked && end > 0 && end <= Date.now()) {
      issues.push({type:'warn', text:'This maintenance window has ended but remains announced until you disable it.'});
    }
    const currentId = parseInt($('#pageId').value || 0);
    const otherNotices = DYNAMIC_PAGES.filter(page =>
      page.page_type === 'maintenance' && page.enabled && page.id !== currentId
    );
    if ($('#pageEnabled').checked && otherNotices.length) {
      issues.push({type:'warn', text:`${otherNotices.length} other maintenance notice${otherNotices.length === 1 ? ' is' : 's are'} enabled; the client displays only the lowest-order one.`});
    }
    if (!issues.some(issue => issue.type === 'err')) issues.push({type:'info', text:'Uses the native SplashMaintenanceWindow and prints both dates in its native format.'});
    return issues;
  }

  const path = backgroundPath(content);
  const unknownActions = Object.keys(content.actions || {}).filter(
    slot => slot !== 'UpsellButton' && slot !== 'CodeRedeemButton'
  );
  if (unknownActions.length) {
    issues.push({type:'err', text:`Unknown client action slot: ${unknownActions.join(', ')}.`});
  }
  if (!path) {
    issues.push({type:'err', text:'Choose background artwork for the landing page.'});
  } else {
    const meta = pageAssetMeta(path);
    if (!meta) issues.push({type:'warn', text:'This custom asset is not in the local preview catalog; verify its client manifest path.'});
    else if (!meta.installed) issues.push({type:'warn', text:`${meta.bundle} will be installed into the server cache when you save.`});
    else issues.push({type:'info', text:'The selected artwork is ready for clients.'});
  }
  if (!labelText(content, 'GameText').trim()) issues.push({type:'warn', text:'No message is set; the page will rely on artwork only.'});
  if ($('#pageEnabled').checked && start > Date.now()) {
    issues.push({type:'info', text:'This landing page is scheduled and will be sent to players after its start time.'});
  } else if ($('#pageEnabled').checked && end > 0 && end <= Date.now()) {
    issues.push({type:'warn', text:'This landing page has expired and is no longer sent to players.'});
  }
  if ($('#pageCta').value !== 'none' && !labelText(content, 'ButtonText').trim()) {
    issues.push({type:'err', text:'Add the text players should see on the action button.'});
  }
  if ($('#pageCta').value === 'url') {
    try {
      const url = new URL($('#pageCtaUrl').value);
      if (!['http:','https:'].includes(url.protocol)) throw new Error('protocol');
    } catch(e) { issues.push({type:'err', text:'Enter a complete http:// or https:// website URL.'}); }
  }
  return issues;
}

function pageEditorChanged() {
  const content = buildDynamicPageContent();
  $('#pageContent').value = JSON.stringify(content, null, 2);
  renderPagePreview(content);
  renderSelectedPageAsset();
  const issues = validateDynamicPage(content);
  $('#pageValidation').innerHTML = issues.map(i =>
    `<div class="validation-row ${i.type === 'info' ? '' : i.type}"><span>${i.type === 'err' ? '!' : i.type === 'warn' ? '~' : 'OK'}</span><span>${esc(i.text)}</span></div>`
  ).join('');
  const errors = issues.filter(i => i.type === 'err');
  $('#pageSaveButton').disabled = errors.length > 0;
  $('#pageSaveState').textContent = errors.length
    ? `${errors.length} item${errors.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} to fix`
    : ($('#pageId').value ? 'Ready to save changes' : 'Ready to create');
}

function renderPagePreview(content) {
  const maintenance = $('#pageType').value === 'maintenance';
  const art = $('#pagePreviewArt');
  const placeholder = $('#pagePreviewPlaceholder');
  const copy = $('#pagePreviewCopy');
  const maintenanceBox = $('#pageMaintenancePreview');

  if (maintenance) {
    art.classList.remove('show');
    placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    copy.style.display = 'none';
    maintenanceBox.style.display = '';
    $('#pageMaintenancePreviewMessage').textContent = labelText(content, 'NotificationBody') || 'Maintenance notice';
    $('#pageMaintenanceStart').textContent = previewDate(content.startTime, 'Set a start');
    $('#pageMaintenanceEnd').textContent = previewDate(content.endTime, 'Set an end');
    $('#pagePreviewCaption').textContent = 'Native maintenance placement; the client prints these dates in the window.';
    return;
  }

  maintenanceBox.style.display = 'none';
  copy.style.display = '';
  const path = backgroundPath(content);
  const name = pageAssetName(path);
  const meta = pageAssetMeta(path);
  const placeholderText = placeholder.querySelector('span:last-child');
  if (name && meta) {
    const assetKey = `${name}:${PAGE_ASSET_REVISION}`;
    if (art.dataset.asset !== assetKey) {
      art.dataset.asset = assetKey;
      art.classList.remove('show');
      placeholder.style.display = '';
      placeholderText.textContent = 'Loading artwork preview...';
      art.onload = () => { art.classList.add('show'); placeholder.style.display = 'none'; };
      art.onerror = () => {
        art.classList.remove('show'); placeholder.style.display = '';
        placeholderText.textContent = 'Artwork preview could not be rendered';
      };
      art.src = pageAssetUrl(name, 'preview');
    } else if (art.complete && art.naturalWidth) {
      art.classList.add('show'); placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    }
  } else {
    art.dataset.asset = '';
    art.removeAttribute('src');
    art.classList.remove('show');
    placeholder.style.display = '';
    placeholderText.textContent = name
      ? 'No local preview is available for this custom asset path'
      : 'Choose artwork to preview the page';
  }

  const template = PAGE_TEMPLATES.find(t => t.id === content.template) || PAGE_TEMPLATES[0];
  copy.className = `game-copy side-${template.copy}`;
  $('#pagePreviewMessage').textContent = labelText(content, 'GameText');
  const ctaKind = $('#pageCta').value;
  const cta = $('#pagePreviewCta');
  if (template.buttons && ctaKind !== 'none') {
    cta.style.display = '';
    cta.textContent = labelText(content, 'ButtonText') || PAGE_CTA_LABELS[ctaKind] || 'LEARN MORE';
    cta.classList.toggle('gold', ctaKind === 'redeem');
  } else {
    cta.style.display = 'none';
  }
  $('#pagePreviewCaption').textContent = `${template.label}; exact client artwork crop and approximate NGUI styling.`;
}

function previewDate(ms, fallback) {
  ms = Number(ms || 0);
  if (!ms) return fallback;
  return new Date(ms).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'});
}

function renderSelectedPageAsset() {
  const path = normalizedPageAssetPath($('#pageAssetPath').value);
  const name = pageAssetName(path);
  const meta = pageAssetMeta(path);
  const thumb = $('#pageAssetThumb');
  if (!name) {
    if (thumb.dataset.asset) thumb.innerHTML = '<span>Select artwork</span>';
    thumb.dataset.asset = '';
    $('#pageAssetStatus').innerHTML = '<span class="muted">Browse the original game art or enter a custom manifest path.</span>';
    return;
  }
  const assetKey = `${name}:${PAGE_ASSET_REVISION}:${meta ? 'catalog' : 'custom'}`;
  if (thumb.dataset.asset !== assetKey) {
    thumb.dataset.asset = assetKey;
    thumb.innerHTML = meta
      ? `<img src="${pageAssetUrl(name, 'thumb')}" alt="" onerror="this.replaceWith(document.createTextNode('Preview unavailable'))">`
      : '<span>Preview unavailable</span>';
  }
  if (!meta) {
    $('#pageAssetStatus').innerHTML = `<span class="pill tag">Custom path</span> <span class="muted">${esc(name)}</span>`;
  } else if (meta.custom) {
    $('#pageAssetStatus').innerHTML = `<span class="pill tag">Custom · ready for players</span> <span class="muted">${esc(meta.title)}</span>`;
  } else if (meta.installed) {
    $('#pageAssetStatus').innerHTML = `<span class="pill on">Ready for players</span> <span class="muted">${esc(meta.title)}</span>`;
  } else {
    $('#pageAssetStatus').innerHTML = `<span class="pill tag">Installs on save</span> <span class="muted">${esc(meta.title)}</span>`;
  }
}

function applyPageJson() {
  try {
    const content = JSON.parse($('#pageContent').value);
    hydratePageEditor({
      id:$('#pageId').value ? parseInt($('#pageId').value) : undefined,
      page_type:$('#pageType').value,
      sort_order:content.sortOrder ?? parseInt($('#pageSort').value || 0),
      enabled:$('#pageEnabled').checked,
      content_json:content
    });
    toast('JSON applied to the visual editor');
  } catch(e) { toast('Invalid JSON: ' + e.message, true); }
}

async function copyPageJson() {
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText($('#pageContent').value); toast('Page JSON copied'); }
  catch(e) { toast('Clipboard access was blocked by the browser', true); }
}

async function savePage() {
  const content = buildDynamicPageContent();
  const issues = validateDynamicPage(content);
  const error = issues.find(i => i.type === 'err');
  if (error) return toast(error.text, true);
  const button = $('#pageSaveButton');
  button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Saving...';
  try {
    const d = await api('pages', {
      id:$('#pageId').value ? parseInt($('#pageId').value) : undefined,
      page_type:$('#pageType').value,
      sort_order:parseInt($('#pageSort').value || 0),
      enabled:$('#pageEnabled').checked,
      content_json:content
    });
    let message = 'Page saved';
    if (d.installed_bundles?.length) message += `; installed ${d.installed_bundles.length} artwork bundle${d.installed_bundles.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    if (d.unresolved_assets?.length) message += '; custom asset path was not found locally';
    toast(message, !!d.unresolved_assets?.length);
    if (d.installed_bundles?.length) await loadPageAssets(true);
    hydratePageEditor(d.page);
    loadPages(); loadOverview();
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
  finally { button.disabled = false; button.textContent = $('#pageId').value ? 'Save changes' : 'Create page'; }
}

async function loadPageAssets(force=false) {
  if (PAGE_ASSETS_LOADED && !force) return;
  try {
    const d = await api(force ? 'pages/assets/refresh' : 'pages/assets', force ? {} : undefined);
    if (force) PAGE_ASSET_REVISION += 1;
    applyPageAssetCatalog(d);
  } catch(e) {
    $('#pageAssetSourceSummary').textContent = 'Could not scan landing-page bundles: ' + e.message;
  }
}

function applyPageAssetCatalog(d) {
  PAGE_ASSETS = d.assets || [];
  PAGE_ASSET_BY_NAME = Object.fromEntries(PAGE_ASSETS.map(a => [a.name.toLowerCase(), a]));
  PAGE_ASSETS_LOADED = true;
  const installed = PAGE_ASSETS.filter(a => a.installed).length;
  const custom = PAGE_ASSETS.filter(a => a.custom).length;
  const sourceText = (d.sources || []).map(s => `${s.textures} from ${s.source}`).join(' + ');
  const errorText = d.errors?.length
    ? ` ${d.errors.length} bundle${d.errors.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} could not be read.`
    : '';
  const customText = custom ? ` ${custom} custom.` : '';
  $('#pageAssetSourceSummary').textContent = PAGE_ASSETS.length
    ? `${PAGE_ASSETS.length} artworks found (${installed} server-ready).${customText} ${sourceText}.${errorText}`
    : `No LandingPage bundles were found. Set PTCGO_CACHE_DIR or place the original cache in this repository.${errorText}`;
  renderPageAssetGrid();
  renderSelectedPageAsset();
  renderPageLibrary();
  if (PAGE_EDITOR_INITIALIZED) pageEditorChanged();
}

async function refreshPageAssets() {
  PAGE_ASSETS_LOADED = false;
  await loadPageAssets(true);
  toast(`Found ${PAGE_ASSETS.length} landing-page artworks, including ${PAGE_ASSETS.filter(a => a.custom).length} custom`);
}

function openPageAssetPicker() {
  $('#pageAssetOverlay').classList.add('open');
  loadPageAssets().then(() => {
    renderPageAssetGrid();
    setTimeout(() => $('#pageAssetSearch').focus(), 30);
  });
}
function closePageAssetPicker() { $('#pageAssetOverlay').classList.remove('open'); }

function openCustomPageArtwork() {
  openPageAssetPicker();
  $('#pageCustomArtworkPanel').open = true;
  setTimeout(() => $('#pageCustomFile').focus(), 60);
}

function customPageAssetName(filename) {
  let name = String(filename || '').replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
  name = name.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  name = name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '').toLowerCase();
  if (name && !name.endsWith('_landingpage')) name += '_landingpage';
  return name;
}

function customPageFileChanged() {
  const file = $('#pageCustomFile').files?.[0];
  const preview = $('#pageCustomPreview');
  $('#pageCustomStatus').textContent = '';
  if (PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL) URL.revokeObjectURL(PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL);
  PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL = '';
  if (!file) {
    preview.innerHTML = '<span>Choose an image</span>';
    return;
  }
  const nameInput = $('#pageCustomName');
  if (!nameInput.value.trim() || nameInput.dataset.auto !== 'false') {
    nameInput.value = customPageAssetName(file.name);
    nameInput.dataset.auto = 'true';
  }
  PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  preview.innerHTML = `<img src="${PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL}" alt="Custom artwork preview">`;
  $('#pageCustomStatus').textContent = `${file.name} · ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`;
}

function readPageImageDataUrl(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('The browser could not read that image'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

async function uploadCustomPageArtwork() {
  const file = $('#pageCustomFile').files?.[0];
  const name = $('#pageCustomName').value.trim();
  const status = $('#pageCustomStatus');
  if (!file) return toast('Choose an artwork image first', true);
  if (!name) return toast('Give the custom artwork an asset name', true);
  if (file.size > 12 * 1024 * 1024) return toast('Custom artwork must be 12 MB or smaller', true);
  if (!['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) return toast('Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image', true);

  const button = $('#pageCustomUploadButton');
  button.disabled = true;
  button.textContent = 'Building Unity bundle...';
  status.textContent = 'Uploading and packing the native 2048×2048 LandingPage texture...';
  try {
    const d = await api('pages/assets/custom', {
      name,
      image:await readPageImageDataUrl(file),
      replace:$('#pageCustomReplace').checked
    });
    PAGE_ASSET_REVISION += 1;
    applyPageAssetCatalog(d);
    const imported = d.asset?.catalog_asset;
    if (!imported) throw new Error('The bundle built, but the new artwork was not cataloged');
    $('#pageCustomFile').value = '';
    $('#pageCustomName').value = '';
    $('#pageCustomName').dataset.auto = 'true';
    $('#pageCustomReplace').checked = false;
    if (PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL) URL.revokeObjectURL(PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL);
    PAGE_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_URL = '';
    $('#pageCustomPreview').innerHTML = '<span>Choose an image</span>';
    selectPageAsset(imported.name);
    toast(`${imported.title} is built, selected, and ready for players`);
  } catch(e) {
    status.textContent = e.message;
    toast(e.message, true);
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
    button.textContent = 'Build & add';
  }
}

function renderPageAssetGrid() {
  const grid = $('#pageAssetGrid');
  if (!grid) return;
  const query = ($('#pageAssetSearch')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const filter = $('#pageAssetFilter')?.value || 'all';
  const selected = pageAssetName($('#pageAssetPath')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
  const matches = PAGE_ASSETS.filter(a => {
    if (filter === 'custom' && !a.custom) return false;
    if (filter === 'installed' && !a.installed) return false;
    if (filter === 'source' && a.installed) return false;
    return !query || `${a.title} ${a.name} ${a.bundle}`.toLowerCase().includes(query);
  });
  grid.innerHTML = matches.map(a => `
    <button class="landing-asset ${a.name.toLowerCase() === selected ? 'sel' : ''}" data-asset="${esc(a.name)}" onclick="selectPageAsset(this.dataset.asset)">
      <img src="${pageAssetUrl(a.name, 'thumb')}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Preview of ${esc(a.title)}" onerror="this.style.visibility='hidden'">
      <span class="landing-asset-info"><span class="landing-asset-name">${esc(a.title)}</span>
        <span class="landing-asset-path">${esc(a.request_path)}</span>
        <span class="landing-asset-sub"><span class="pill ${a.custom ? 'tag' : (a.installed ? 'on' : 'tag')}">${a.custom ? 'custom' : (a.installed ? 'ready' : 'installs on save')}</span><span>${a.width}×${a.height}</span><span>${esc(a.bundle)}</span></span>
      </span>
    </button>`).join('') || '<div class="empty-page-library">No artwork matches this filter.</div>';
}

function selectPageAsset(name) {
  const meta = pageAssetMeta(name);
  $('#pageAssetPath').value = meta?.request_path || `LandingPage/${name}`;
  closePageAssetPicker();
  pageAssetPathChanged();
}

async function loadPages() {
  try {
    const d = await api('pages');
    DYNAMIC_PAGES = d.pages || [];
    renderPageLibrary();
    if (!PAGE_EDITOR_INITIALIZED) {
      PAGE_EDITOR_INITIALIZED = true;
      newDynamicPage('landing');
    }
  } catch(e) { toast('Pages: ' + e.message, true); }
}

function pageStatus(page) {
  if (!page.enabled) return {label:'disabled', cls:'off'};
  const now = Date.now(), start = Number(page.content_json?.startTime || 0), end = Number(page.content_json?.endTime || 0);
  if (page.page_type === 'maintenance') {
    if (end && end <= now) return {label:'needs disable', cls:'off'};
    if (start > now) return {label:'announced', cls:'tag'};
    return {label:'in progress', cls:'on'};
  }
  if (start > now) return {label:'upcoming', cls:'tag'};
  if (end && end <= now) return {label:'expired', cls:'off'};
  return {label:'live', cls:'on'};
}

function pageSummary(page) {
  const key = page.page_type === 'maintenance' ? 'NotificationBody' : 'GameText';
  return labelText(page.content_json, key).trim() || (page.page_type === 'maintenance' ? 'Maintenance notice' : 'Artwork-only landing page');
}

function renderPageLibrary() {
  const filter = $('#pageLibraryFilter')?.value || 'all';
  const pages = DYNAMIC_PAGES.filter(p => filter === 'all' || p.page_type === filter);
  $('#pagesGrid').innerHTML = pages.map(p => {
    const status = pageStatus(p);
    const path = backgroundPath(p.content_json);
    const name = pageAssetName(path);
    const meta = pageAssetMeta(path);
    const art = p.page_type === 'landing' && name && meta
      ? `<img src="${pageAssetUrl(name, 'thumb')}" loading="lazy" alt="" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
      : `<div class="game-art-placeholder"><span class="pokeball"></span><span>${p.page_type === 'maintenance' ? 'Maintenance window' : 'No artwork'}</span></div>`;
    const template = p.content_json?.template || '';
    return `<article class="page-card">
      <div class="page-card-art">${art}<div class="page-card-badges"><span class="pill tag">${p.page_type === 'maintenance' ? 'maintenance' : 'landing'}</span><span class="right pill ${status.cls}">${status.label}</span></div><span class="page-order">order ${p.sort_order}</span></div>
      <div class="page-card-body"><div class="page-card-title">${esc(pageSummary(p).slice(0,110))}</div>
        <div class="page-card-meta">#${p.id} &middot; ${esc(template)} &middot; ${esc(pageScheduleText(p.content_json))}</div>
        <div class="page-card-actions"><button class="mini" onclick="editPageById(${p.id})">Edit</button><button class="mini" onclick="duplicatePage(${p.id})">Duplicate</button><button class="mini" onclick="togglePage(${p.id})">${p.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}</button><button class="mini" onclick="deletePage(${p.id})">Delete</button></div>
      </div></article>`;
  }).join('') || '<div class="empty-page-library">No dynamic pages yet. Build one above and its in-game preview will appear here.</div>';
}

function pageScheduleText(content) {
  const start = Number(content?.startTime || 0), end = Number(content?.endTime || 0);
  if (!start && (!end || end >= PAGE_FOREVER)) return 'always available';
  if (start > Date.now()) return 'starts ' + new Date(start).toLocaleDateString();
  if (end && end < PAGE_FOREVER) return 'ends ' + new Date(end).toLocaleDateString();
  return 'active now';
}

function editPageById(id) {
  const page = DYNAMIC_PAGES.find(p => p.id === id);
  if (!page) return;
  hydratePageEditor(page);
  document.querySelector('#tab-pages').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
}
function editPage(page) { hydratePageEditor(page); }

function duplicatePage(id) {
  const page = DYNAMIC_PAGES.find(p => p.id === id);
  if (!page) return;
  hydratePageEditor({...cloneJson(page), id:undefined, enabled:false, sort_order:(parseInt(page.sort_order) || 0) + 1});
  $('#pageEditorKicker').textContent = `Duplicate of page #${id}`;
  toast('Duplicate prepared as a disabled draft; review it and save');
  document.querySelector('#tab-pages').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
}

async function togglePage(id) {
  try { await api('pages/toggle', {id}); await loadPages(); loadOverview(); }
  catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}

async function deletePage(id) {
  if (!confirm('Delete page ' + id + '? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  try {
    await api('pages/delete', {id});
    if (String(id) === $('#pageId').value) newDynamicPage();
    loadPages(); loadOverview(); toast('Page deleted');
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}

/* ---------------- Trades ---------------- */
async function loadTrades() {
  try {
    const d = await api('trades');
    const fmt = o => Object.entries(o || {}).map(([g,c]) => `${c}× ${g.slice(0,8)}…`).join(', ') || '—';
    $('#tradesTable tbody').innerHTML = d.trades.map(t => `
      <tr><td class="muted">${esc(t.offer_id.slice(0,8))}…</td><td>${esc(t.sender_id.slice(0,8))}…</td>
      <td>${t.recipient_id ? esc(t.recipient_id.slice(0,8)) + '…' : '<span class="pill tag">public</span>'}</td>
      <td>${esc(fmt(t.offering))}</td><td>${esc(fmt(t.requesting))}</td>
      <td><span class="pill ${t.status === 'open' ? 'on' : 'tag'}">${esc(t.status)}</span></td></tr>`).join('')
      || '<tr><td colspan="6" class="muted">No trade offers.</td></tr>';
  } catch(e) { toast('Trades: ' + e.message, true); }
}

/* ---------------- Versus Seasons ---------------- */
let SEASONS = [], VS_SEL = 0;

function msToLocal(ms) {
  const d = new Date(ms || 0);
  d.setMinutes(d.getMinutes() - d.getTimezoneOffset());
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}
function localToMs(v) { return v ? new Date(v).getTime() : 0; }

function vsDirty(on) { $('#vsDirty').style.display = on ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
function vsSeason() { return SEASONS[VS_SEL]; }
function vsField(field, value) { vsSeason()[field] = value; vsDirty(true); if (field === 'seasonID') renderSeasonPills(); }
function vsDescInput(v) { vsSeason().description = {id: v}; vsDirty(true); }

function defaultSeason(n) {
  return {seasonID: `Season${n}`, startTime: Date.now(), endTime: 4102444800000,
          description: {id: `SpiritPTCGO Season ${n}`}, resetRewardID: "", _tiers: [{ms: []}]};
}
function parseTiers(season) {
  const tiers = (season.tiers || []).map(t => ({
    ms: Object.entries(t.rewards || {})
      .map(([pts, rewards]) => ({points: parseInt(pts) || 0, rewards: expandRewards(rewards)}))
      .sort((a, b) => a.points - b.points)
  }));
  return tiers.length ? tiers : [{ms: []}];
}

async function loadVersus() {
  try {
    const d = await api('versus-seasons');
    SEASONS = (d.seasons || []).map(s => ({...s, _tiers: parseTiers(s)}));
    if (!SEASONS.length) SEASONS = [defaultSeason(1)];
    VS_SEL = Math.min(VS_SEL, SEASONS.length - 1);
    vsDirty(false);
    renderVersus();
    const guids = SEASONS.flatMap(s => s._tiers.flatMap(t => t.ms.flatMap(m => m.rewards)))
      .filter(r => r.rewardType === 'Archetype' && r.rewardProductID)
      .map(r => r.rewardProductID);
    if (await resolveCardMeta(guids)) renderVersus();
  } catch(e) { toast('Versus: ' + e.message, true); }
}

function renderSeasonPills() {
  $('#seasonPills').innerHTML = SEASONS.map((s, i) =>
    `<button class="season-pill ${i === VS_SEL ? 'sel' : ''}" onclick="selectSeason(${i})">${esc(s.seasonID || '(unnamed)')}</button>`
  ).join('') +
  `<button class="mini" onclick="addSeason()">+ New season</button>` +
  (SEASONS.length > 1 ? `<button class="mini" onclick="deleteSeason()">Delete selected</button>` : '');
}
function selectSeason(i) { VS_SEL = i; renderVersus(); }
function addSeason() { SEASONS.push(defaultSeason(SEASONS.length + 1)); VS_SEL = SEASONS.length - 1; vsDirty(true); renderVersus(); }
function deleteSeason() {
  if (!confirm(`Delete season "${vsSeason().seasonID}" from the config?`)) return;
  SEASONS.splice(VS_SEL, 1); VS_SEL = 0; vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}

/* The client shows a reward's quantity by COUNTING duplicate entries in the
   milestone array (rewardAmount is ignored for Archetype rewards), so identical
   products/cards are stored as N entries. Group them into one stepper chip. */
function groupRewards(rewards) {
  const groups = [], byKey = {};
  (rewards || []).forEach((r, idx) => {
    const key = r.rewardType === 'Archetype'
      ? 'A:' + String(r.rewardProductID || '').toLowerCase()
      : 'T:' + idx;                       // tokens never merge — they carry their own amount
    if (byKey[key] === undefined) { byKey[key] = groups.length; groups.push({reward: r, indices: []}); }
    groups[byKey[key]].indices.push(idx);
  });
  return groups;
}
function expandRewards(rewards) {
  const out = [];
  (rewards || []).forEach(r => {
    if (r.rewardType === 'Archetype' && (r.rewardAmount || 1) > 1) {
      const n = Math.max(1, r.rewardAmount | 0);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) out.push({...r, rewardAmount: 1});
    } else { out.push(r); }
  });
  return out;
}
function rewardGroupChip(g, stepPrefix, removePrefix) {
  const r = g.reward, n = g.indices.length;
  if (r.rewardType === 'Archetype') {
    const m = metaFor(r.rewardProductID) || {name: r.name || 'Unknown', image: null};
    const art = m.image ? `<img src="${esc(m.image)}" onerror="this.remove()">` : '<div class="coin">🎴</div>';
    return `<div class="reward-chip">${art}<span class="rc-name">${esc(m.name)}</span>
      <span class="rc-step">
        <button class="rc-pm" title="Remove one" onclick="${stepPrefix},-1)">−</button>
        <span class="rc-amt">×${n}</span>
        <button class="rc-pm" title="Add one" onclick="${stepPrefix},1)">+</button>
      </span>
      <button class="chip-x" title="Remove all" onclick="${removePrefix})">✕</button></div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="reward-chip"><div class="coin">🪙</div>
    <span class="rc-name">${esc(r.name || 'Tokens')}</span><span class="rc-amt">${r.rewardAmount || 0}</span>
    <button class="chip-x" title="Remove" onclick="${removePrefix})">✕</button></div>`;
}

function milestoneHTML(m, ti, mi) {
  const hasArchetype = m.rewards.some(r => r.rewardType === 'Archetype' && r.rewardProductID);
  const warn = m.rewards.length >= 2 && !hasArchetype
    ? '<div class="ms-warn">⚠ A milestone with several rewards must include a card or product — the game crashes rendering an all-tokens group.</div>' : '';
  return `
    <div class="milestone">
      <div class="ms-badge">
        <input type="number" min="1" value="${m.points}" onchange="msPoints(${ti},${mi}, this.value)">
        <span class="pts">pts</span>
      </div>
      <div class="ms-body">
        ${groupRewards(m.rewards).map((g, gi) => rewardGroupChip(g,
            `vsRewardStep(${ti},${mi},${gi}`, `vsRewardRemoveGroup(${ti},${mi},${gi}`)).join('')}
        <button class="add-chip" onclick="openRewardPicker('versus', ${ti}, ${mi})">+ Reward</button>
        ${warn}
      </div>
      <button class="mini ms-del" onclick="delMilestone(${ti},${mi})">✕ Milestone</button>
    </div>`;
}

function renderVersus() {
  renderSeasonPills();
  const s = vsSeason();
  $('#vsSeasonId').value = s.seasonID || '';
  $('#vsDesc').value = (s.description && s.description.id) || '';
  $('#vsStart').value = msToLocal(s.startTime);
  $('#vsEnd').value = msToLocal(s.endTime);
  $('#tiersWrap').innerHTML = s._tiers.map((t, ti) => `
    <div class="tier-box">
      <div class="tier-head">
        <h3>Tier ${ti + 1}</h3>
        ${s._tiers.length > 1 ? `<button class="mini" onclick="delTier(${ti})">✕ Tier</button>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="ladder">
        ${t.ms.map((m, mi) => milestoneHTML(m, ti, mi)).join('')
          || '<div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:12px">No milestones in this tier yet.</div>'}
      </div>
      <button class="btn ghost" style="margin-bottom:12px" onclick="addMilestone(${ti})">+ Add milestone</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function msPoints(ti, mi, v) {
  const t = vsSeason()._tiers[ti];
  t.ms[mi].points = Math.max(1, parseInt(v) || 1);
  t.ms.sort((a, b) => a.points - b.points);
  vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}
function lastPoints(tiers) {
  const all = tiers.flatMap(t => t.ms.map(m => m.points));
  return all.length ? Math.max(...all) : 0;
}
function addTier() {
  vsSeason()._tiers.push({ms: []});
  vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}
function delTier(ti) {
  const t = vsSeason()._tiers[ti];
  if (t.ms.length && !confirm(`Delete Tier ${ti + 1} and its ${t.ms.length} milestone(s)?`)) return;
  vsSeason()._tiers.splice(ti, 1);
  vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}
function addMilestone(ti) {
  const last = lastPoints(vsSeason()._tiers);
  vsSeason()._tiers[ti].ms.push({points: last ? last * 2 : 10, rewards: []});
  vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}
function delMilestone(ti, mi) { vsSeason()._tiers[ti].ms.splice(mi, 1); vsDirty(true); renderVersus(); }
function vsRewardStep(ti, mi, gi, delta) {
  const rewards = vsSeason()._tiers[ti].ms[mi].rewards;
  const g = groupRewards(rewards)[gi]; if (!g) return;
  if (delta > 0) rewards.push({...g.reward, rewardAmount: 1});
  else rewards.splice(g.indices[g.indices.length - 1], 1);
  vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}
function vsRewardRemoveGroup(ti, mi, gi) {
  const rewards = vsSeason()._tiers[ti].ms[mi].rewards;
  const g = groupRewards(rewards)[gi]; if (!g) return;
  g.indices.slice().sort((a, b) => b - a).forEach(idx => rewards.splice(idx, 1));
  vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
}

async function saveSeasons() {
  const out = SEASONS.map(s => ({
    seasonID: s.seasonID, startTime: s.startTime, endTime: s.endTime,
    description: s.description, resetRewardID: s.resetRewardID || "",
    tiers: s._tiers.map(t => ({
      rewards: Object.fromEntries(t.ms
        .filter(m => m.points > 0 && m.rewards.length)
        .sort((a, b) => a.points - b.points)
        .map(m => [String(m.points), m.rewards]))
    })).filter(t => Object.keys(t.rewards).length)
  }));
  try {
    await api('versus-seasons', {seasons: out});
    vsDirty(false);
    toast('Versus seasons saved & reloaded');
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}

/* ---------------- Async Tournaments ---------------- */
let TOURS = [], T_SEL = 0;

function defaultTournament(n) {
  const now = Date.now(), day = 86400000;
  return {tournament_id: null, enabled: true, entries: 0, definition: {
    name: `Tournament ${n}`, title: `Tournament ${n}`, description: "",
    img: "", background: "", url: "", prizeBy: "wins",
    previewTime: now, startTime: now, entryClosingTime: now + 7 * day,
    resolutionTime: now + 8 * day, disappearTime: now + 14 * day,
    maxRuns: 0,
    maxSize: 8, format: "Unlimited", matchStructure: "SingleElimination",
    roundLength: 30, delayBetweenRounds: 10,
    run: {entryFee: [], allowDeckSwitching: true, maxWins: 3, maxLosses: 3, maxGames: 0, prizeTable: []},
    leaderboard: {runs: 0, winValue: 3, lossValue: 1, prizeTable: []}
  }};
}
function tSel() { return TOURS[T_SEL]; }
function tDef() { return tSel().definition; }
function tDirty(on) { $('#tDirty').style.display = on ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
function tField(field, value) { tDef()[field] = value; tDirty(true); if (field === 'name') renderTourPills(); }
function tRunField(field, value) { tDef().run[field] = value; tDirty(true); }
function tLbField(field, value) { tDef().leaderboard[field] = value; tDirty(true); }
function tFeesChanged() {
  const fees = [];
  const add = (cur, id) => { const n = parseInt($(id).value) || 0; if (n > 0) fees.push({currency: cur, amount: n}); };
  add('Tokens', '#tFeeTokens'); add('Gems', '#tFeeGems'); add('Tickets', '#tFeeTickets');
  tDef().run.entryFee = fees; tDirty(true);
}

/* ---------------- Play formats ---------------- */
let FORMATS = [], FORMAT_SETS = [];
function fmtDirty(on) { $('#fmtDirty').style.display = on ? '' : 'none'; }
async function loadFormats() {
  try {
    const d = await api('formats');
    FORMATS = d.formats; FORMAT_SETS = d.sets;
    renderFormats(); fmtDirty(false);
  } catch(e) { toast('Formats: ' + e.message, true); }
}
function renderFormats() {
  $('#formatMatrix thead').innerHTML = '<tr><th>Set</th>' +
    FORMATS.map(f => `<th style="text-align:center">${esc(f.key)}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>';
  $('#formatMatrix tbody').innerHTML = FORMAT_SETS.map(set =>
    `<tr><td><code>${esc(set)}</code></td>` + FORMATS.map((f, fi) => {
      const on = f.allSets || f.sets.includes(set);
      return `<td style="text-align:center"><input type="checkbox" ${on ? 'checked' : ''}` +
             `${f.allSets ? ' disabled title="format allows all sets"' : ''}` +
             ` onchange="fmtToggleSet(${fi}, '${esc(set)}', this.checked)"></td>`;
    }).join('') + '</tr>').join('');
  $('#formatExceptions').innerHTML = FORMATS.map((f, fi) => `
    <div style="margin-bottom:16px">
      <b>${esc(f.key)}</b> <span class="muted">(${f.allSets ? 'all sets' : f.sets.length + ' sets'})</span>
      <div class="row">
        <div style="flex:1;min-width:280px"><label>Banned cards</label>
          <textarea rows="2" style="width:100%" onchange="fmtRefs(${fi}, 'bannedCards', this.value)">${esc(f.bannedCards.join(', '))}</textarea></div>
        <div style="flex:1;min-width:280px"><label>Extra legal cards</label>
          <textarea rows="2" style="width:100%" onchange="fmtRefs(${fi}, 'extraLegalCards', this.value)">${esc(f.extraLegalCards.join(', '))}</textarea></div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function fmtToggleSet(fi, set, on) {
  const sets = FORMATS[fi].sets;
  const i = sets.indexOf(set);
  if (on && i < 0) sets.push(set);
  if (!on && i >= 0) sets.splice(i, 1);
  fmtDirty(true);
}
function fmtRefs(fi, field, value) {
  FORMATS[fi][field] = value.split(/[\n,]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  fmtDirty(true);
}
async function saveFormats() {
  try {
    const d = await api('formats', {formats: FORMATS});
    FORMATS = d.formats; renderFormats(); fmtDirty(false);
    toast('Formats saved — deck validation reloaded');
  } catch(e) { toast('Save failed: ' + e.message, true); }
}

async function loadTournaments() {
  try {
    const d = await api('tournaments');
    TOURS = d.tournaments || [];
    TOURS.forEach(t => [t.definition && t.definition.run, t.definition && t.definition.leaderboard]
      .forEach(x => (x && x.prizeTable || []).forEach(p => { p.rewards = expandRewards(p.rewards); })));
    if (!TOURS.length) TOURS = [defaultTournament(1)];
    T_SEL = Math.min(T_SEL, TOURS.length - 1);
    tDirty(false);
    renderTournaments();
    const guids = TOURS.flatMap(t => [t.definition.run, t.definition.leaderboard]
      .flatMap(x => (x && x.prizeTable || []).flatMap(p => p.rewards || [])))
      .filter(r => r.rewardType === 'Archetype' && r.rewardProductID)
      .map(r => r.rewardProductID);
    if (await resolveCardMeta(guids)) renderTournaments();
  } catch(e) { toast('Tournaments: ' + e.message, true); }
}
function renderTourPills() {
  $('#tourPills').innerHTML = TOURS.map((t, i) =>
    `<button class="season-pill ${i === T_SEL ? 'sel' : ''}" onclick="selectTournament(${i})">
       ${esc(t.definition.name || '(unnamed)')}${t.enabled ? '' : ' 🚫'}</button>`).join('') +
    `<button class="mini" onclick="addTournament()">+ New tournament</button>`;
}
function selectTournament(i) { T_SEL = i; renderTournaments(); }
function addTournament() { TOURS.push(defaultTournament(TOURS.length + 1)); T_SEL = TOURS.length - 1; tDirty(true); renderTournaments(); }

function prizeRowHTML(kind, p, i) {
  const unit = kind === 'run' ? 'place/wins' : 'rank';
  return `<div class="prize-row">
    <div class="prize-range">
      <label>${unit} from</label><input type="number" min="0" value="${p.start}" onchange="prizeRange('${kind}',${i},'start',this.value)">
      <label>to</label><input type="number" min="0" value="${p.end}" onchange="prizeRange('${kind}',${i},'end',this.value)">
    </div>
    <div class="prize-rewards">
      ${groupRewards(p.rewards).map((g, gi) => rewardGroupChip(g,
          `tourRewardStep('${kind}',${i},${gi}`, `tourRewardRemoveGroup('${kind}',${i},${gi}`)).join('')}
      <button class="add-chip" style="padding:10px 14px" onclick="openRewardPicker('${kind === 'run' ? 'trun' : 'tlb'}', ${i})">+ Reward</button>
    </div>
    <button class="mini ms-del" onclick="delPrizeRow('${kind}',${i})">✕ Row</button>
  </div>`;
}
function tourRewardStep(kind, i, gi, delta) {
  const rewards = prizeTableOf(kind)[i].rewards;
  const g = groupRewards(rewards)[gi]; if (!g) return;
  if (delta > 0) rewards.push({...g.reward, rewardAmount: 1});
  else rewards.splice(g.indices[g.indices.length - 1], 1);
  tDirty(true); renderTournaments();
}
function tourRewardRemoveGroup(kind, i, gi) {
  const rewards = prizeTableOf(kind)[i].rewards;
  const g = groupRewards(rewards)[gi]; if (!g) return;
  g.indices.slice().sort((a, b) => b - a).forEach(idx => rewards.splice(idx, 1));
  tDirty(true); renderTournaments();
}
function prizeTableOf(kind) {
  return kind === 'run' ? tDef().run.prizeTable : tDef().leaderboard.prizeTable;
}
function prizeRange(kind, i, field, v) { prizeTableOf(kind)[i][field] = Math.max(0, parseInt(v) || 0); tDirty(true); }
function addPrizeRow(kind) {
  const table = prizeTableOf(kind);
  const last = table.length ? table[table.length - 1].end : (kind === 'run' ? -1 : 0);
  table.push({start: last + 1, end: last + 1, rewards: []});
  tDirty(true); renderTournaments();
}
function delPrizeRow(kind, i) { prizeTableOf(kind).splice(i, 1); tDirty(true); renderTournaments(); }

function renderTournaments() {
  renderTourPills();
  const t = tSel(), d = t.definition, run = d.run || {}, lb = d.leaderboard || {};
  $('#tName').value = d.name || '';
  $('#tTitle').value = (d.title && d.title.id) || d.title || '';
  $('#tDesc').value = (d.description && d.description.id) || d.description || '';
  $('#tMaxRuns').value = d.maxRuns || 0;
  $('#tMaxSize').value = String(d.maxSize || 8);
  $('#tFormat').value = d.format || 'Unlimited';
  $('#tRoundLength').value = d.roundLength || 30;
  $('#tRoundDelay').value = d.delayBetweenRounds || 10;
  $('#tPreview').value = msToLocal(d.previewTime);
  $('#tStart').value = msToLocal(d.startTime);
  $('#tEntryClose').value = msToLocal(d.entryClosingTime);
  $('#tResolve').value = msToLocal(d.resolutionTime);
  $('#tDisappear').value = msToLocal(d.disappearTime);
  $('#tMaxWins').value = run.maxWins || 0;
  $('#tMaxLosses').value = run.maxLosses || 0;
  $('#tMaxGames').value = run.maxGames || 0;
  $('#tDeckSwitch').checked = run.allowDeckSwitching !== false;
  const fee = cur => (run.entryFee || []).find(f => f.currency === cur);
  $('#tFeeTokens').value = (fee('Tokens') || {}).amount || 0;
  $('#tFeeGems').value = (fee('Gems') || {}).amount || 0;
  $('#tFeeTickets').value = (fee('Tickets') || {}).amount || 0;
  $('#tWinValue').value = lb.winValue ?? 3;
  $('#tLossValue').value = lb.lossValue ?? 1;
  $('#tRunPrizes').innerHTML = (run.prizeTable || []).map((p, i) => prizeRowHTML('run', p, i)).join('')
    || '<div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:10px">No run prizes yet.</div>';
  $('#tLbPrizes').innerHTML = (lb.prizeTable || []).map((p, i) => prizeRowHTML('leaderboard', p, i)).join('')
    || '<div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:10px">No leaderboard prizes yet.</div>';
  $('#tToggleBtn').textContent = t.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable';
  $('#tMeta').textContent = t.tournament_id
    ? `${t.tournament_id} · ${t.entries || 0} entries · ${t.enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}`
    : 'not saved yet';
  $('#tStandings').innerHTML = '';
}

async function saveTournament() {
  const t = tSel();
  const d = t.definition;
  d.title = String($('#tTitle').value || d.name);
  d.description = String($('#tDesc').value || '');
  try {
    const res = await api('tournaments', {
      tournament_id: t.tournament_id || undefined,
      definition: d,
      enabled: t.enabled
    });
    t.tournament_id = res.tournament.tournament_id;
    tDirty(false);
    toast('Tournament saved & live');
    renderTournaments();
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}
async function toggleTournament() {
  const t = tSel();
  if (!t.tournament_id) { t.enabled = !t.enabled; tDirty(true); renderTournaments(); return; }
  try {
    const res = await api('tournaments/toggle', {tournament_id: t.tournament_id});
    t.enabled = res.tournament.enabled;
    toast(t.enabled ? 'Tournament enabled' : 'Tournament disabled');
    renderTournaments();
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}
async function deleteTournament() {
  const t = tSel();
  if (!t.tournament_id) { TOURS.splice(T_SEL, 1); if (!TOURS.length) TOURS = [defaultTournament(1)]; T_SEL = 0; renderTournaments(); return; }
  if (!confirm(`Delete tournament "${t.definition.name}" and ALL its entries?`)) return;
  try {
    await api('tournaments/delete', {tournament_id: t.tournament_id});
    toast('Deleted'); T_SEL = 0; loadTournaments();
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}
async function viewStandings() {
  const t = tSel();

        `</tbody></table>`
      : '<div class="muted">No entrants yet.</div>';
  } catch(e) { toast(e.message, true); }
}

function pickerValidate() {

function pickerAdd() {
  const count = Math.max(1, parseInt($('#pickerCount').value) || 1);
  if (PICKER.sel.kind === 'tokens') {
    const n = Math.max(1, parseInt($('#tokenAmount').value) || 1);
    dispatchReward({name: `${n} Tokens`, rewardType: 'Tokens', rewardAmount: n, rewardCurrency: 'prizeTrainerCoin'});
  } else {
    const {guid, name, image} = PICKER.sel;
    CARD_META[guid.toLowerCase()] = CARD_META[guid.toLowerCase()] || {name, image};
    if (PICKER.mode === 'codes') {
      REWARD.products[guid] = (REWARD.products[guid] || 0) + count;
      updateRewardItems();
    } else {
      // one entry per copy — the client renders the quantity from array length
      const base = {name, rewardType: 'Archetype', rewardAmount: 1,
                    rewardProductID: guid, rewardDescription: {id: name}, flavor: name};
      dispatchRewards(Array.from({length: count}, () => ({...base})));
    }
  }
  closePicker();
}
function dispatchRewards(rewards) {
  if (PICKER.mode === 'versus') {
    vsSeason()._tiers[PICKER.tierIndex].ms[PICKER.msIndex].rewards.push(...rewards);
    vsDirty(true); renderVersus();
  } else if (PICKER.mode === 'trun' || PICKER.mode === 'tlb') {
    prizeTableOf(PICKER.mode === 'trun' ? 'run' : 'leaderboard')[PICKER.tierIndex].rewards.push(...rewards);
    tDirty(true); renderTournaments();
  }
}
function dispatchReward(reward) { dispatchRewards([reward]); }

async function bootData() {
  await loadProducts();
  loadOverview(); loadAccounts(); loadCodes(); loadShop(); loadTrades(); loadVersus(); loadTournaments(); loadFormats();
}

})();
